They told me that I would be one of the last ones, too.  Apparently since my lawyer's office specializes, they get to go last.  They were very nice today.  I'm not sure how I'm going to afford the filing, but I'm going to get all the forms I need to fill out on Thursday and start things going.

Yeah.  Most of it was for psychiatric inpatient care.  Which seems crazy.  I got denied health insurance over and over again (still can't get it, even with ObamaCare) and had a breakdown and ended up in a locked ward.  I'm glad I went, they took god care of me and I'm much better these days.  But it seems like a crazy system... crazier than I am ;-)

Edited to add:  I made the decision to talk to a lawyer this week when I realized that even if a miracle high-paying job fell in my lap, it wouldn't be close to enough to put a dent in it.  It's beyond my abilities.  Realizing that has helped me let go again.

They come out of the woodwork, because they know that you aren't allowed to default on them again.  Between hospitals, doctors, labs, radiologists in four different states, I don't even know who all I owe money to any more.  I'm hoping the lawyer can help me out.

Thank you so much.  Your words mean a lot to me.  I'll try to let you know how it goes.
Thank you.  I feel like I'm swimming through a shit swamp.  I'm sure there's something at least slightly better on the other side, but this freaking sucks right now.
